verses.transcription: ilaa nabiyyin rasuulin jaa-anaa bihudaa
muzih tadaa bikitaabin jaabihi fahadaa

verses.text: أَبْقَى تَحَايَا بِلَا غِشٍ وَلَا كَدَرٍ
verses.transcription: abqaa tahaayaa bilaa ghishin walaa kadarin
minal khadiimil lazii yanhuuhu multahadaa
li-aalihil ghurri wal as-haabi qaatibatan
minnii salaamun yudiimul amna war raghadaa
yaa sayyidii yaa rasuulal laahi yaa amalii

verses.text: صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ الَّذِى قَصَّى الَّذِى مَرَدَا
verses.transcription: sallaa halaykal lazii qassal lazii maradaa
yaa muntaqaa yaa imaamal mursaliina mahan

verses.text: عَلَيْكَ تَسْلِيمُ مَنْ صَفَّى بِكَ الْخَلَدَا
verses.transcription: halayka tasliimu man saffaa bikal khaladaa
sallaa halayka bitasliimin bilaa hadadin

verses.text: مَنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ قَطُّ مَوْلُودًا وَلَمْ يَلِدَا
verses.transcription: man lam yakun qattu mawluudan wa lam yalidaa
sallaa wa sallama baaqin laa shariika lahu
halayka bil aali yaa man zahzahal fanadaa
sallaa wa sallamaa baaqin laa nafaada lahu
halayka bis sahbi yaa man qarrabar rashadaa
ahlul madiinati minnii sarmadan lakumu
abqaa salaamin yutiibul qalba wal jasadaa
laa ziltumud dahra fii sawfin wa tawsihatin
yakfiikumul laahu lil jannaati man hanadaa

verses.text: فُزْتُمْ بِكَوْنِ ابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جَارَكُمُ
verses.transcription: fuztum bikawnibni habdil laahi jaarakumu
wa kawnakum hawlahu faltahmadus samadaa

verses.text: صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ الَّذِى يَنْفِى الْعِدَى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: sallaa halayhil lazii yanfil hidaa abadan

verses.text: إِلَى سِوَى مَنْ نَّحَاهُ الدَّهْرَ مُلْتَحَدَا
verses.transcription: ilaa siwaa man nahaahud dahra multahadaa
tasurruhu min hayaatii khidmatun qubilat

verses.text: مِنِّى بِفَضْلِ الَّذِى أَهْدَى بِهِ فَهَدَى
verses.transcription: minnii bifadlil lazii ahdaa bihi fahadaa

bayts.text: إِلَى نَبِىٍّ رَّسُولٍ جَآءَنَا بِهُدَى ۞ مُذِ اهْتَدَى بِكِتَابٍ جَآبِهِ فَهَدَى

translations.it.karamati: A un Profeta, Inviato, che ci è venuto con la guida, da quando fu guidato da un Libro che egli recò, e (ci) guidò,
translations.en.karamati: To a Prophet, a Messenger, who came to us with guidance, since he was guided by a Book he brought, and guided (us),
translations.fr.karamati: À un Prophète, Envoyé, qui nous est venu avec la guidance, depuis qu'il fut guidé par un Livre qu'il apporta, et (nous) guida,

bayts.text: أَبْقَى تَحَايَا بِلَا غِشٍ وَلَا كَدَرٍ ۞ مِنَ الْخَدِيمِ الَّذِى يَنْحُوهُ مُلْتَحَدَا

translations.it.karamati: i saluti più durevoli, senza inganno né torbidezza, dal Servitore (al-Khadīm) che si dirige a lui come a un rifugio.
translations.en.karamati: the most lasting greetings, without deceit or turbidity, from the Servant (al-Khadīm) who turns to him as to a refuge.
translations.fr.karamati: les salutations les plus durables, sans tromperie ni trouble, de la part du Serviteur (al-Khadīm) qui se dirige vers lui comme vers un refuge.

bayts.text: لِئَالِهِ الْغُرِّ وَالْأَصْحَابِ قَاطِبَةً ۞ مِّنِّى سَلَامٌ يُدِيمُ الْأَمْنَ وَالرَّغَدَا

translations.it.karamati: Alla sua Famiglia illustre e a tutti i Compagni, da parte mia, un saluto che perpetua la sicurezza e l'agiatezza.
translations.en.karamati: To his illustrious Family and to all the Companions, from me, a greeting that makes security and ease endure.
translations.fr.karamati: À sa Famille illustre et à tous les Compagnons, de ma part, un salut qui perpétue la sécurité et l'aisance.

bayts.text: يَاسَيِّدِى يَارَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَآ أَمَلِى ۞ صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ الَّذِى قَصَّى الَّذِى مَرَدَا

translations.it.karamati: O mio signore, o Inviato di Allah, o mia speranza, ti benedica Colui che ha allontanato chi si è ribellato.
translations.en.karamati: O my master, O Messenger of Allah, O my hope, may He bless you Who has driven away whoever rebelled.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô mon maître, ô Envoyé d'Allah, ô mon espérance, que te bénisse Celui qui a écarté celui qui s'est rebellé.

bayts.text: يَامُنْتَقَى يَآ إِمَامَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ مَعًا ۞ عَلَيْكَ تَسْلِيمُ مَنْ صَفَّى بِكَ الْخَلَدَا

translations.it.karamati: O Prescelto, o guida di tutti gli inviati insieme, su di te il saluto di Colui che per mezzo tuo ha purificato l'animo.
translations.en.karamati: O Select One, O leader of all the messengers together, upon you the greeting of Him Who through you has purified the heart.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Préféré, ô guide de tous les envoyés ensemble, sur toi le salut de Celui qui par toi a purifié l'âme.

bayts.text: صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ بِتَسْلِيمٍ بِلَا عَدَدٍ ۞ مَنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ قَطُّ مَوْلُودًا وَلَمْ يَلِدَا

translations.it.karamati: Ti benedica, con un saluto senza numero, Colui che non è mai stato generato e non ha generato (Corano 112:3).
translations.en.karamati: May He bless you, with a greeting beyond number, Who was never begotten and has not begotten (Qurʾān 112:3).
translations.fr.karamati: Que te bénisse, avec un salut sans nombre, Celui qui n'a jamais été engendré et n'a pas engendré (Coran 112:3).

bayts.text: صَلَّى وَسَلَّمَ بَاقٍ لَّاشَرِيكَ لَهُ ۞ عَلَيْكَ بِالْئَالِ يَامَنْ زَحْزَحَ الْفَنَدَا

translations.it.karamati: Ti benedica e ti dia pace un Permanente (Al-Bāqī) che non ha associati, insieme alla Famiglia, o tu che hai allontanato la menzogna.
translations.en.karamati: May an Everlasting One (Al-Bāqī) Who has no partner bless you and grant you peace, together with the Family, O you who drove falsehood away.
translations.fr.karamati: Que te bénisse et t'accorde la paix un Permanent (Al-Bāqī) qui n'a point d'associé, ainsi que la Famille, ô toi qui as écarté le mensonge.

bayts.text: صَلَّى وَسَلَّمَ بَاقٍ لَّانَفَادَ لَهُ ۞ عَلَيْكَ بِالصَّحْبِ يَامَنْ قَرَّبَ الرَّشَدَا

translations.it.karamati: Ti benedica e ti dia pace un Permanente che non ha esaurimento, insieme ai Compagni, o tu che hai avvicinato la rettitudine.
translations.en.karamati: May an Everlasting One Who knows no exhaustion bless you and grant you peace, together with the Companions, O you who brought right conduct near.
translations.fr.karamati: Que te bénisse et t'accorde la paix un Permanent qui ne s'épuise point, ainsi que les Compagnons, ô toi qui as rapproché la rectitude.

bayts.text: أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنِّى سَرْمَدًا لَّكُمُ ۞ أَبْقَى سَلَامٍ يُطِيبُ الْقَلْبَ وَالْجَسَدَا

translations.it.karamati: O gente di Medina, da parte mia, per sempre, a voi il saluto più durevole, che rende buoni il cuore e il corpo.
translations.en.karamati: O people of Medina, from me, for ever, to you the most lasting greeting, which makes heart and body wholesome.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô gens de Médine, de ma part, pour toujours, à vous le salut le plus durable, qui rend bons le cœur et le corps.

bayts.text: لَازِلْتُمُ الدَّهْرَ فِى صَفْوٍ وَتَوْسِعَةٍ ۞ يَكْفِيكُمُ اللَّهُ لِلْجَنَّاتِ مَنْ عَنَدَا

translations.it.karamati: Possiate restare sempre nella serenità e nell'abbondanza; Allah vi preservi, fino ai Giardini, da chi si ostina (nella ribellione).
translations.en.karamati: May you ever remain in serenity and abundance; may Allah shield you, until the Gardens, from whoever persists (in rebellion).
translations.fr.karamati: Puissiez-vous demeurer toujours dans la sérénité et l'abondance ; qu'Allah vous préserve, jusqu'aux Jardins, de quiconque s'obstine (dans la rébellion).

bayts.text: فُزْتُمْ بِكَوْنِ ابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جَارَكُمُ ۞ وَكَوْنَكُمْ حَوْلَهُ فَلْتَحْمَدُواْ الصَّمَدَا

translations.it.karamati: Avete ottenuto che il figlio di ʿAbd Allāh sia vostro vicino, e che voi siate intorno a lui: lodate dunque l'Assoluto (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
translations.en.karamati: You have won that the son of ʿAbd Allāh is your neighbour, and that you are around him: so praise the Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
translations.fr.karamati: Vous avez obtenu que le fils de ʿAbd Allāh soit votre voisin, et que vous soyez autour de lui : louez donc l'Absolu (Aṣ-Ṣamad).

bayts.text: صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ الَّذِى يَنْفِى الْعِدَى أَبَدًا ۞ إِلَى سِوَى مَنْ نَّحَاهُ الدَّهْرَ مُلْتَحَدَا

translations.it.karamati: Lo benedica Colui che respinge sempre i nemici verso altri che chi si dirige a lui, per sempre, come a un rifugio.
translations.en.karamati: May He bless him Who ever repels the enemies toward others than whoever turns to him, for ever, as to a refuge.
translations.fr.karamati: Que le bénisse Celui qui repousse toujours les ennemis vers d'autres que celui qui se dirige vers lui, pour toujours, comme vers un refuge.

bayts.text: تَسُرُّهُ مِنْ حَيَاتِى خِدْمَةٌ قُبِلَتْ ۞ مِنِّى بِفَضْلِ الَّذِى أَهْدَى بِهِ فَهَدَى

translations.it.karamati: Lo rallegri, della mia vita, un servizio da me accolto per la grazia di Colui che per mezzo di lui ha fatto dono (della guida) e ha guidato.
translations.en.karamati: May a service of my life, accepted from me, gladden him, by the grace of Him Who through him bestowed (guidance) and guided.
translations.fr.karamati: Que le réjouisse, de ma vie, un service de moi agréé par la grâce de Celui qui par lui a fait don (de la guidance) et a guidé.
